## About
B-OK Transmission is a car repair shop on Waldo St in Houston. Transmissions are what we know best, and we also handle brakes, air conditioning, electrical diagnosis, shocks and struts, tires and everyday maintenance.
Our shop manager, Isaac, starts with a proper diagnosis. One customer wrote that other shops told him he needed a full rebuild, and we repaired the part that had actually failed instead. When a rebuild is the right call, we do that too.
We hold a 4.9 rating from 78 Google reviews. Call us or stop by Monday through Saturday.

## Services
- Transmission repair and service: We fix the problem we find and can service the transmission with new fluid and filter.
- Transmission work: When a transmission needs more than a repair, we have rebuilt them and looked for other issues along the way.
- Brake repair and rotors: Brake work and rotor service for your car or truck.
- Air conditioning service and repair: AC service and repairs to keep your car comfortable on Houston roads.
- Electrical system diagnosis: We look into electrical problems and find where they are coming from.
- Shocks and struts replacement: Replacement shocks and struts for a steadier ride.
- Tires and wheel balancing: Tire work and wheel balancing.
- Auto maintenance services: Routine maintenance to keep your vehicle running well.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on transmissions?
A: No. Transmissions are our focus, but we also do brakes, AC, electrical diagnosis, shocks and struts, tires and maintenance. One customer said we helped with other issues not related to the transmission.

Q: Are you open on the weekend?
A: We are open Saturday from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM and closed on Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We are at 3906 Waldo St #3 in Houston, TX 77063.
